items.title: Michael Penix: Solid numbers in lopsided loss
items.text:
Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Quiet after ankle injury
items.text:
Kelce secured both targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Woody Marks: Not likely to be cleared for Thursday's game
items.text:
Coach DeMeco Ryans acknowledged after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns that Marks (concussion) is unlikely to play in Thursday night's game against the Colts, ESPN.com's DJ Bien-Aime reports.

items.title: Kyle Pitts: Four catches in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Pitts brought in four of five targets for 50 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Downs: Productive in team debut
items.text:
Downs secured four of five targets for 53 yards and a touchdown, fumbled once but recovered and returned three punts for 10 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
